game_20260217_223017_g8:11.description: At 2 life facing an opponent with 16 life and 7 cards in hand, Llama4 Sarge copied Oblivious Bookworm instead of Deep-Cavern Bat with Superior Spider-Man. Deep-Cavern Bat gives a 4/4 with flying (evasion past Enduring Curiosity blocks), lifelink (desperately needed at 2 life to stabilize), and hand disruption (exile a key card from the opponent's full hand). Oblivious Bookworm just draws a card that must be discarded and provides no evasion or life gain.

game_20260217_223017_g8:24.description: Kimi25 Snark attempted to cast Shoot the Sheriff to kill Superior Spider-Man (4/4) during combat but failed to complete the mana payment, resulting in taking the full 6 damage from both attackers. The mana was available (Gloomlake Verge for B, Fountainport for C), and alternatively Floodpits Drowner could have been flashed in to tap one attacker. The opponent is at 2 life, so surviving to attack back with the two Enduring Curiosities is critical.

game_20260217_223017_g8:3.description: Cast Enduring Curiosity (a flash creature) during postcombat main phase, using all 4 mana, when they could have cast Shoot the Sheriff on Oblivious Bookworm (a card advantage engine) for 2 mana and saved Enduring Curiosity for flash deployment on the opponent's turn. This wastes flash's advantage and leaves the Bookworm alive to generate value.

game_20260217_223017_g8:7.description: Chose to copy Wistfulness with Superior Spider-Man, getting a 4/4 body with no useful abilities (Wistfulness's ETB triggers require {G}{G} or {U}{U} spent to cast, which Superior Spider-Man doesn't provide). Copying Oblivious Bookworm would have given the same 4/4 body plus a repeatable end-step card draw engine, which is very valuable when the player only has 2 cards in hand.

game_20260219_091818_g6:43.description: Young Wolf is primarily a combo piece with Yawgmoth, but the combo is still far from assembled (Yawgmoth costs 4 mana and Agatha's Soul Cauldron costs 2). Playing Wooded Foothills first and fetching a land would enable casting Badgermole Cub (1G), which provides mana acceleration via earthbend and its tap-creature-for-mana ability, potentially enabling Yawgmoth a turn earlier.

game_20260226_003306_g4:14.description: Playing Boseiju, Who Endures as a land instead of Eldrazi Temple. Boseiju's main value is its Channel ability (usable from hand), while Eldrazi Temple needs to be on the battlefield to provide its bonus mana for Eldrazi spells. Both lands allow casting Glaring Fleshraker this turn, but Eldrazi Temple on the battlefield is significantly more valuable in this Eldrazi-heavy deck, and Boseiju could be held in hand for its Channel destruction ability.

game_20260226_003306_g4:22.description: Fetched Blood Crypt paying 2 life when a basic Mountain would have provided all the mana needed. With Blood Crypt already untapped providing B, fetching Mountain (free, untapped) gives R + B = enough for Orcish Bowmasters post-combat. The 2 life is wasted.

game_20260226_003306_g4:3.description: Bottomed Hollow One, which is the key payoff for the Turn 1 Burning Inquiry line. With Mountain + Burning Inquiry in hand, casting Burning Inquiry discards 3 cards, making Hollow One free (cost reduced by 6 from 5). This is the deck's signature explosive opening - a free 4/4 on turn 1, potentially alongside a pumped Marauding Mako.

game_20260226_003306_g4:32.description: Playing Mountain instead of Bloodstained Mire is slightly suboptimal. Bloodstained Mire provides deck thinning, future color flexibility (can fetch Swamp or Mountain as needed), and shuffle effects. At 15 life, the 1 life cost is negligible. Keeping the Mountain in hand for a future land drop is strictly worse than keeping the Mire for future flexibility.

game_20260226_003306_g4:6.description: Chose Walking Ballista over Eldrazi Temple from the Devourer of Destiny reveal. With Ugin's Labyrinth and one Eldrazi Temple already in hand, a second Eldrazi Temple on top guarantees a powerful land drop next turn and accelerates the Eldrazi game plan significantly. The player's hand is already land-light (only 4 lands including Boseiju) and needs mana development to deploy Glaring Fleshraker and eventually Devourer of Destiny.

game_20260226_003306_g5:19.description: Casting Doomsday with no way to draw into the pile this turn. After resolving, Sonnet Tactic will be at 10 life with an empty hand, no mana, and a 5-card library against a Goblin deck that's developing its board with Aether Vial. They cannot win this turn and will likely die to Goblin aggression before assembling a win from the pile.

game_20260228_010846_g4:4.description: Bottoming Hunter's Insight leaves the hand with 4 lands and only 2 spells (Chilling Trap and Crashing Tide), which is very land-heavy. While Hunter's Insight is conditional (needs a creature in play connecting for damage), it has very high upside as a card draw engine. The third Island could have been bottomed instead to keep more action.
